paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with Tunable TM_020 mode
notes: Cavity haloscope search using tunable TM020 mode, mass range 21.38-21.79 ueV (5.17-5.27 GHz). Limit stated as g_agamma > 12.0 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL. KSVZ coupling at ~21.6 ueV is roughly 3.5e-14 GeV^-1, so 12x ~4.2e-13 GeV^-1. Paper abstract states 'approximately 10^-13 GeV^-1'. Exact numerical values from Fig.6 not tabulated in text; the two-point line approximates the roughly flat exclusion across the narrow mass band. rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm3 assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.6, 2))
